title: Expro Advances Digital Well Integrity Management Through Integrated Partnership with Evoilve
summary: Expro advances digital well integrity management through integrated partnership with Evoilve with the launch of SafeWells® V5, a next-generation digital…
body_markdown:
*Developed and brought to market through an integrated partnership between Expro and Evoilve, SafeWells® V5 combines Expro's well integrity expertise with Evoilve’s next-generation cloud technology to deliver a smarter, more connected approach to digital well integrity assurance.*


Expro is advancing digital well integrity management through its integrated partnership with Evoilve with the launch of SafeWells® V5, a next-generation digital platform designed to help operators improve visibility, strengthen operational assurance and make better-informed decisions across the well lifecycle.


The partnership combines Expro’s decades of well integrity Expertise and industry knowledge with Evoilve’s specialist software technology and digital product development capabilities. Together the companies have developed a connected digital solution bringing well integrity surveillance, workflow automation, collaborative decision-making and integrated assurance processes within a single digital environment.


SafeWells® V5 extends beyond traditional integrity issue management to provide a comprehensive well and barrier management solution, helping operators connect data, people and processes, standardize workflows and strengthen assurance across increasingly complex well portfolios.


SafeWells® V5 is already gaining traction in the market. Expro and Evoilve have jointly delivered solutions and issued quotations covering tens of thousands of wells, while the platform is currently live with several customers.


**Alan Quirke, Vice President for Well Intervention & Integrity at Expro, said** :


*"The industry is increasingly looking for digital solutions that combine technical innovation with practical operational expertise. Through our partnership with Evoilve, we have created a platform that helps operators take a more connected and proactive approach to managing well and barrier performance throughout the asset lifecycle.*


*“SafeWells® V5 represents a significant step forward in digital well integrity assurance, connecting data, people and engineering expertise to help operators safeguard well integrity, maximize well availability and strengthen operational assurance."*
